name: gsheets-pro-local
description: Starts the bundled gsheets-pro MCP server over stdio using your own Google OAuth client. Enable it alongside the gsheets-pro plugin, which carries the skill, the presets, and the hooks. Stdio servers do not start in Claude Code cloud sessions; host the server over HTTP for those.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_client_id.description: The client ID of a Desktop app OAuth client in your own Google Cloud project. Run /gsheets-pro:setup for the walkthrough. Leave empty to use Application Default Credentials from the gcloud CLI instead.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_client_secret.description: The client secret that pairs with the client ID above. Stored in your system keychain, never in settings.json.

default_preset.title: Default style preset
default_preset.description: Which preset new spreadsheets get when a request does not name one. Ships with neutral, park, and finance-classic.
